title: AI-generated pixel art of a top-down blacksmith hut in several different themes
author: Rsloth

comments.author: Yenii_3025
comments.body:
Very nice. Did you start with an ai image and then adapt it manuall? 

If not whats your work flow?

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body: In [magicpixel.art](https://magicpixel.art) \- First I generated new "top-down blacksmith building" with max or quality setting. With that artboard selected as reference, then I generated variants > reskin creative with random and quality settings on to get the reskins.

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body: And of course I get downvoted lol

replies.author: ffxivthrowaway03
replies.body:
I don't think you deserve to be downvoted for answering the question, but I do think people are getting tired of these "Look at this cool AI asset" posts and then the workflow just happens to be "I swiped my credit card at one of these fly by night AI asset generator websites that are just wrappers for some ComfyUI backend."  People get frustrated because they're hoping for consistent, reproducible workflows to make quality assets after constantly being sold snake oil asset generators where it's really just gambling for random gens you hope you can even use.

They did come out pretty though.

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body: I get it and I understand the frustration, I would be frustrated too. At the same time people need to understand that it's garbage in garbage out. The AI models need something to grab onto otherwise yes you're just rolling the dice. If I can generate consistent assets with this, anyone can.

comments.author: DuckAndQwack
comments.body: Some of them don't have the blacksmith :(

comments.author: ffxivthrowaway03
comments.body:
For the love of god, slow down the transitions and at least align them to be correctly overlapping.

We didn't install this light switch so The Cheat could throw light switch raves.

comments.author: GaiusVictor
comments.body: Please, please, please correct the pixel drift

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body: It's just a demo, but yeah production assets I would definitely fix that.

comments.author: MintDrake
comments.body: Why the hell you would need all of those variations?

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: Yeap, I'm also getting pretty sick of combing through poster's history to see if they're a genuine person asking yet another ai pixel art question, of whether this is someone who owns a commercial tool and is posting disingenuous psuedo advertising. The OP has many posts now basically doing the same thing.
